Frequently Asked Questions

Why does a Hauz Khas showroom need an interior architect for showroom design?

Hauz Khas has strong walk-in traffic and many competing stores. A planned façade, display and lighting help your showroom stand out and turn visitors into buyers.

Can you design a boutique or concept store?

Yes. Boutiques and concept stores need flexible displays, trial rooms and a clear brand story, which we plan around your product range.

How do you plan customer movement in a showroom?

We place hero products near the entry, create a natural route through the store and keep the billing area visible but not in the way.

Do you coordinate with brand and signage teams?

Yes. As the interior architect for showroom design, we coordinate with your brand, signage and lighting vendors so everything fits together on site.
